The '''LCK 2023 Summer''' Split was the second split of the 2023 [[League of Legends Champions Korea]] season, organized by Riot Games. It took place from June 7 to August 20, with the Group Stage held offline at LoL Park in Seoul and the Lower Bracket Final and Grand Final hosted at the Daejeon Convention Center in Daejeon. Ten teams competed in a Double Round Robin Group Stage using best-of-three matches, with the top six advancing to a Double Elimination Playoffs played as best-of-five. The winner qualified for the [[World Championship/2023|2023 World Championship]]. The split was played across patches 13.10 to 13.14, with Ivern, Rell, and Naafiri disabled at various points for competitive integrity. Due to patch issues in the [[LCK CL/2023/Summer|LCK Challengers League]], Week 6 reverted from patch 13.13 to 13.12.

==Format==
*'''Regular Season''' - ''June 7<sup>th</sup> - August 6<sup>th</sup>, 2023''
**Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to the Semifinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd till 6th place''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''6th till 10th place''}} are eliminated from this split.
*'''Playoffs''' - ''August 8<sup>th</sup> - 22<sup>nd</sup>, 2023''
** Double Elimination
** {{Ordinal|3}} place team from group stage can choose the opponent for first round
** {{Ordinal|1}} placed team from group stage can choose the opponent from first round
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Winner qualifies for [[World Championship/2023|World Championship 2023]]
